step_1_ai_cost_profile.methodology: static analysis of call paths in intelligence/ask_intrinsiciq/

stages.notes: Evidence package rarely changes; safe to cache by evidence fingerprint
Each call reviews one claim independently; major batching opportunity
Input is the generated answer; cache keyed by answer fingerprint
Each call validates one relationship independently; major batching opportunity
Input is composition plan; plan is deterministic once claims/rels are stable

step_2_3_cache_architecture.key_formula: sha256(json.dumps({model, system_prompt, prompt, temperature, schema_version}, sort_keys=True))
invalidation_rules: model change → different fingerprint → automatic miss
prompt change (evidence, claims, relationships) → different fingerprint → automatic miss
system_prompt change → different fingerprint → automatic miss
schema_version increment → different fingerprint → automatic miss
temperature change → different fingerprint → automatic miss
cache write failures are non-fatal; pipeline continues
step_2_3_cache_architecture.safety_guarantee: Identical inputs = identical fingerprint. Any dependency change produces a different fingerprint and a guaranteed cache miss. No stale result can be served to a changed input.

safety_properties: Each claim receives an independent verdict
Failure for one claim does not contaminate others
Malformed or invalid verdict → VERDICT_REVIEW_ERROR (never auto-accept)
Claim absent from batch response → VERDICT_REVIEW_ERROR
Full batch AI failure → VERDICT_REVIEW_ERROR for all claims in batch
Cache-backed: identical batch input returns cached result
step_4_batch_claim_review.schema: reviews: [{claim_id, verdict, confidence, reason, scope_issues, qualifications_missing}]

safety_properties: Each relationship receives an independent verdict
Acceptance contract applied per-relationship after batch returns (identical to single-rel path)
Malformed response item → _error_result → NEEDS_REVIEW via acceptance contract
Relationship absent from batch response → NEEDS_REVIEW
Full batch AI failure → NEEDS_REVIEW for all relationships in batch
Cache-backed: identical batch input returns cached result
Level 3 validation contract unchanged — same apply_acceptance_contract() called

notes: ai_claim_reviewer.py already receives only cited evidence items (not full package)
relationship_reviewer.py uses _resolve_evidence with max_items=5 per ref list
evidence_reasoner.py sends the full package but only for the generative step — appropriate
No additional reduction needed without weakening validation
